faq.title: Questions About Admissions & School Life
faq.subtitle: Answers to common questions from prospective students and parents.
faq.a1: Wave 1 (Merit & Early Bird) opens 15 October 2026. Wave 2 (Regular) opens 15 January 2027. Apply online on this site or at the school secretariat.
faq.q2: Are scholarships available for high-achieving students?
faq.a2: Yes. Merit scholarships (50%–100% tuition reduction) are available for science olympiad winners, Quran memorization (min. 3 juz), or city/province-level sports and arts champions.
faq.q3: What curriculum and learning approach do you use?
faq.a3: We implement Kurikulum Merdeka enriched with Cambridge international content, research-based P5 projects, AI and robotics integration, and character education.
faq.q4: Can parents schedule a campus tour?
faq.a4: Yes. Visit on weekdays (Mon–Fri 08:00–14:00 WIB) or Saturday by appointment via our WhatsApp hotline.
